text:
Morgan: :rotating_light: Heads up — alert from incident-broker: outbound paging failed for customer 'acme-inc'. IncidentBot created but pages didn't go out.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-4521 created. Attempted pages: 3. Successful pages: 0. Error: webhook delivery failures to notify-orch.

Jess: Confirming — PagerDuty shows no active incidents for that service. No on-call got notified.

Priya: I'm seeing a flood of 403s in notify-orch logs starting ~09:12 (post config rollout). Example:
```
POST /webhook/pager 403 - {"error":"signature_mismatch","expected":"sha256=...","received":"sha256=..."}
```

Ryan: Did we rotate any signing keys today? I see a KMS rotation job in the deploy logs at 09:10.

Priya: Yes — key rotation for notify-keys rolled at 09:11 by key-manager. I thought notify-orch picked up the new key but looks like the env var didn't update in the helm release.

Kim: I didn't get pages. I'm oncall and didn't see any PD alerts. Can someone manually page me? @Jess

Jess: Paging manually via PD UI now — done. Kim: got the manual page.

Morgan: Ok manual paging mitigated immediate on-call gap. Root cause likely mis-synced signing key after rotation; notify-orch rejected webhooks from incident-broker.

Priya: Quick mitigation — I'm going to update notify-orch config with the new key and restart pods. I'll run a small test after.

DeployBot: notify-orch prod pods restarted (3/3) by Priya — image v2.14.7

Priya: pushed key and restarted. Running a replay of recent webhook deliveries:
```
for id in 4521 4522 4523; do curl -X POST https://notify-orch.prod/webhook/replay -d "id=$id"; done
```

SRE-Triage: Observability shows webhook error rate dropping to 0. Pages retried and PD incidents created for two of three replays.

Kim: I got the replays as PD incidents and received pages. All good from my side.

Morgan: Action items: 1) Follow-up retro + runbook for key rotations and env propagation (Priya) 2) Add health check alert on webhook 5xx/403 spike (SRE-Triage) 3) Improve incident-broker retry visibility (Jess).

Priya: Will create a PR for runbook and add an automated check to the key-rotation flow to verify notify-orch envs within 10m.

Jess: I'll file a small ticket to surface webhook delivery failures to the incidents channel automatically (so humans see page failures in real time).

Morgan: Thanks all. Marking this as mitigated. We'll include timeline in the postmortem.
